verdict.rationale: Datalab documents on-prem deployment, letting customers run its models on their own infrastructure, with containers, a Helm chart for Kubernetes and air-gapped Enterprise options. That full self-hosted product requires an Enterprise contract, though. The core engines (Marker, Surya, Chandra) are free open source that users run themselves, but this covers conversion rather than the full platform (pipelines, form filling, webhooks). Missing for 10: self-hosting the full platform without an Enterprise contract, detailed public deployment docs beyond the overview and Helm mention, independent hands-on reports of the on-prem container.
